verdict.justification: The project proposes a mobile app for finding and offering tutoring services using a recommendation system. The app aims to match users with suitable tutors based on their specific needs, reducing uncertainty for the user. This aligns with the Information Systems category as it is a domain-specific application for an organization (Universidad del Valle sede Tuluá), and the primary novelty is the implementation of a recommendation system which falls under the Recommender Systems secondary category.
